title: European banks line up exchange partners for 2026 stablecoin launch
summary: Qivalis, a consortium of 12 European banks, is reportedly in talks with crypto exchanges ahead of its euro stablecoin launch in the second half of 2026.

title: Aave proposal clears first hurdle with 52.6% support amid governance split
summary: The Snapshot Temp Check passed 52.6% to 42%, sending the DAO-funded revenue model to the ARFC stage for revisions.

title: South Korea orders cross-agency probe after repeated crypto custody failures
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yun-cheol ordered an inter-agency review of seized crypto wallets after the National Tax Service exposed a seed phrase in a press release.

title: Bitcoin to see tailwinds if AI prompts ‘easier monetary policy’: NYDIG
summary: NYDIG’s Greg Cipolaro says AI could be a “general-purpose technology,” and its effects on the economy could be a boon for Bitcoin.

title: Fed could print money to support US conflict with Iran, says Hayes
summary: Arthur Hayes says the longer Donald Trump engages in expensive “Iranian nation-building,” the more likely it is that the Federal Reserve will boost money supply.

title: February crypto losses hit lowest level since March 2025, says PeckShield
summary: PeckShield said fewer mega-hacks, heightened volatility and tighter risk controls may have helped push crypto losses to their lowest level in 11 months.

title: Magic Eden winds down EVM, Bitcoin NFT markets to focus on gambling
summary: Magic Eden is shifting resources from NFTs to its casino platform Dicey, after a closed beta saw $15 million wagered by around 200 users in two months.

title: AI ‘vibe coding’ could put Ethereum roadmap ahead of schedule: Vitalik Buterin
summary: Vitalik Buterin says AI coding still has “massive caveats,” but people should expect Ethereum’s roadmap to be finished much faster than expected.

title: Trump Media weighs Truth Social spinoff as crypto expansion accelerates
summary: Trump Media expanded into crypto in 2025 with its fintech brand Truth.Fi, creating a Bitcoin treasury, filing multiple crypto ETFs, and forming a partnership with Crypto.com.

title: X allows paid crypto promotions but bans them in EU, UK
summary: X’s head of product, Nikita Bier, said the new paid promotion label is designed to help users monetize content while remaining transparent with followers.
